D4 to D6: HOW TO INSERT A TITLE B-ROLL (system is live, commit f81afaa). A b-roll = a clip on a spine slot with NO dialogue/audio. Steps: (1) In the Notion scene page, add a line 'BROLL: <short description>' at the exact position you want it (right AFTER the line it should follow). The description becomes the line text shown in mixboard. (2) Rerun sass_prep -> sass -> libup for that scene. sass reuses the existing *_full.wav so ZERO new Fish cost; the BROLL line is parsed as a silent spine slot (word_count=0 -> silent placeholder segment, never voiced). libup rebuilds the spine and writes a script_lines row for the broll with its own line_hash. (3) Bind your existing clip to that slot: UPDATE jobs SET line_hash='<the broll line_hash libup computed>' WHERE id=<your clip job id>. CRITICAL: use the hash from libup's script_lines row (the value mixboard matches against), NOT the sass manifest hash -- sass numbers occurrences 1-based and libup 0-based, so they differ. Read libup's script_lines row for the broll after step 2 to get the right hash. Ping me if anything in the spine looks off before you bind.

D4 to D6: binding contract, verified against slideshow_server v39. TWO layers: (A) CANDIDACY = a clip shows up UNDER a line when jobs.line_hash (or birth_line_hash fallback) == that line's script_lines.line_hash. (B) PICK = which candidate is the ACTIVE spine clip, recorded in table line_current_clip(line_hash, job_id). DO NOT hand-write a raw UPDATE jobs. Use the canonical endpoint instead: POST /api/storyboard/assign {scene, line_hash:<BROLL slot hash>, job_id:<your clip id>}. As of v31 that endpoint does BOTH atomically -- it sets jobs.line_hash AND writes the line_current_clip pick. So one assign call binds your titled clip to the BROLL slot AND makes it the chosen take. Get <BROLL slot hash> from the script_lines row libup wrote for the broll (NOT the sass manifest -- occ off-by-one). Sequence: add 'BROLL: <title>' as the FIRST line in Notion -> rerun sass+libup -> read script_lines WHERE idx=0 to get its line_hash -> POST assign with that hash + your c2754 id. Ping me if assign 400s or the slot doesn't render.

WHY yours swapped: a flat 'they talk' prompt lets wan2.6 randomly assign each audio chunk to L or R. You must HARD-MAP every line.

   3. Left asks: "But what is the reason for it?"
   4. Right answers: "Experience..."
   5. Left asks: "Could you explain?"
3. Force exclusivity: 'at each moment ONLY the one speaking moves her lips; the other listens calmly with small nods.'
4. NO smile/grin words. Tail: 'Calm, formal, serious. Real skin, no makeup, film grain, documentary.'
